tools.name: audit_x402
tools.description: Audit a public HTTPS x402 endpoint without paying it. Fetches the unpaid 402 challenge, decodes it, checks scheme/network/asset/amount/payTo/resource URL and free discovery files, and returns advisory findings with a score. Read-only; never signs or sends a payment.

tools.name: web_text_extract
tools.description: Fetch one public HTTP(S) page and return its title, meta description, best-effort readable main text excerpt, normalized length, SHA-256 digest and UTC time. Read-only, size-limited and SSRF-guarded; never invents content or pays the target.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Free liveness check. Returns the service name and a UTC timestamp.
